summary: Before upgrading, edit the installer inventory (cd into ansible-automation-platform-setup-bundle-2.6-4-x86_64 or setup-2.6-4), keep or update parameters, and add or remove nodes. Use reachable IPs or FQDNs, never localhost, or preflight checks stop the upgrade. Samples are in ansible/test-topologies.
questions: Can I reuse my existing inventory file for the AAP 2.6 upgrade?
Why does the upgrade stop when localhost is in the inventory?
How do I add cluster nodes during an upgrade?
